create.name: Lisa Campion
create.bio:
Lisa Campion is a psychic counsellor and Reiki master teacher based in south-eastern Massachusetts. She grew up outside Boston, began reading professionally at nineteen and has now spent more than four decades giving one-to-one sessions, mostly over Zoom, with occasional in-person appointments at her office in Swansea. She spent fifteen years running student affairs at a school of energy medicine, and she has taught Reiki for well over twenty-five years.

Her teaching is aimed at sensitive people, empaths and new healers who want to understand their intuition and look after their own energy. She developed a style she calls Psychic Reiki, a framework of nine psychic senses and a method she names Quantum Light Wave Healing, and she offers recorded classes, a six-month mentorship and a live soul-reading salon online. She co-founded the Quantum Mystic School of Consciousness, presents weekend programmes at Kripalu and hosts The Miracle of Healing podcast, talking with mediums and healers. Her books include The Art of Psychic Reiki, Awakening Your Psychic Ability and a guide to energy and boundaries for empaths.

books.title: The Art of Psychic Reiki: Developing Your Intuitive and Empathic Abilities for Energy Healing
books.author: Lisa Campion
books.description: A step-by-step introduction to Reiki that pairs the hand positions and attunement levels with exercises for noticing and trusting intuitive impressions. Lisa writes for beginners and practitioners who find that energy work is opening up their psychic senses.

books.title: Energy Healing for Empaths: How to Protect Yourself from Energy Vampires, Honor Your Boundaries, and Build Healthier Relationships
books.author: Lisa Campion
books.description: A practical guide for highly sensitive readers on noticing when other people's moods and demands are draining them. It offers simple energy practices and ways of setting boundaries in families, friendships and work.

books.title: Awakening Your Psychic Ability: A Practical Guide to Develop Your Intuition, Demystify the Spiritual World, and Open Your Psychic Senses
books.author: Lisa Campion
books.description: Lisa sets out her map of the psychic senses and the different layers of the spirit world, with exercises for building intuition step by step. It is written for people whose sensitivity has arrived unexpectedly and who want a grounded way to work with it.

courses.title: Mastering Your Psychic Ability
courses.description: A six-month small-group mentorship for intuitives, healers and helping professionals who want to sharpen their psychic skills. It combines live calls, a private group and short one-to-one check-ins with Lisa.

courses.title: Awakening Your Psychic Abilities
courses.description: A five-week recorded class on recognising your own intuitive senses and getting to know your guides. Each session comes as video and audio, with guided meditations to practise between lessons.

courses.title: Opening Your Psychic Senses
courses.description: A short recorded class with practical techniques for noticing and strengthening inner knowing. A low-cost starting point for people new to psychic development.

courses.title: Mastering Your Empathy
courses.description: A ten-module online course for empaths on understanding their sensitivity and managing the energy they pick up from people and places. It includes a bonus class on energetic protection.

courses.title: The Soul Reading Salon
courses.description: A live virtual gathering in which Lisa gives soul-level readings to participants in a small group setting. Salons are held regularly online.

courses.title: Private Psychic and Energy Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one soul reading and energy sessions by Zoom, with a limited number of in-person appointments at Lisa's office in Swansea, Massachusetts. Half-hour and one-hour sessions and packages are available.

free_resources.title: Psychic Empowerment: How to Control and Manage Psychic Experiences
free_resources.description: A free one-hour recorded workshop for people whose psychic sensitivity has opened suddenly. Lisa explains how to steady these experiences and work with them on purpose.

free_resources.title: Activate Your Intuitive Wisdom
free_resources.description: A free one-hour training on making intuitive impressions more dependable. It covers a practical method for checking and trusting the guidance you receive.
